design: Designed from the open pack's 20 Jolly Roger pictures. Slots 0-4, the commonly met captains, use each picture exactly once over the four nations, so every common captain is told apart by his flag; look-alikes (the plain skulls 4/5/9, the skeletons 1/15/18, the hearts 16/17) sit in different nations. Rows lean to a style: Spain the red-and-gold and baroque designs, England the human figures, France the hat, bandana and cutlasses, Holland the three skulls, red skeleton and hearts. Slot 5 (rare) borrows a flag from another nation not resembling its own row; slots 6-7 (practically never met) repeat the row's first two.
